cores.working_definition: Selective prioritization and maintenance of information/action under limited processing, shaped by goals, stimulus properties and selection history.
cores.notes: Must separate initial capture/control from sustained attention and learned selection history.

cores.working_definition: A family of motivational/affective processes that assign value to resolving or exploring informational uncertainty and novelty.
cores.notes: Do not reduce to information gap; curiosity can be blocked by cost/threat and competing drives.

cores.working_definition: Umbrella family containing subjective valuation/appraisal processes and affective/emotional states that jointly shape relevance, motivation and action.
cores.notes: Valuation and emotion are clearly non-identical; minimum architecture requires separate modules and R2 must test top-level split.

cores.working_definition: Self- and group-representations that shape categorization, relevance, norms, signaling and social influence.
cores.notes: Similarity/homophily is not identity itself; norms need explicit mediation/moderation structure.

cores.working_definition: Willingness/reliance under uncertainty informed by judgments such as trustworthiness, competence, authenticity and reliability.
cores.notes: Credibility cues and trust antecedents must not be equated with calibrated trust or message truth.

cores.working_definition: Perceived relational bond with a creator/source, spanning episodic parasocial interaction, more enduring parasocial relationship, familiarity and attachment.
cores.notes: PSI and PSR must be separate; real reciprocal relationship processes cannot be silently folded into parasocial mechanisms.

cores.working_definition: Behavioral transmission of information/opinions to others through sharing, recommending, discussing or forwarding, with motives modeled separately.
cores.notes: Keep psychological sharing behavior separate from algorithmic/network exposure and from motives for sharing.

cores.working_definition: Umbrella family containing outcome-based learning/value updating and context-linked habitual control supporting recurrence.
cores.notes: Reinforcement learning and habit are distinct; returning is an outcome, not a mechanism. R2 must test whether umbrella remains useful.
